name: Contact, reply time
description: A soft tinted panel that says when to expect a reply, with the email and phone and three rows of icon and text. No form.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: We reply within one working day

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.default: Write as much or as little as you like. Nobody at Tidewater answers from a script, so a proper reply takes a little time.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: Messages wait safely until the next working morning.

default.title: Read every weekday at 8:00
default.text: Anything sent after 17:00 or at the weekend is first in the queue the next working morning.

default.title: Answered by a physiotherapist
default.text: Jo, Amara or Felix replies in person and can already suggest who to book with.

default.title: Sharp or sudden pain? Call instead
default.text: The front desk picks up from 8:00 to 18:00 and keeps two same-day slots free.
